note: Literature directly describes adult-onset progressive cerebellar ataxia in RAB3A/SCA52 accompanied by mild gait spasticity, tremors, and vermian cerebellar atrophy.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with RAB3A p.Arg83Trp presented with adult-onset, gradually progressive cerebellar ataxia often accompanied by mild gait spasticity and tremors, with brain MRI consistently revealing cerebellar atrophy accentuated in the vermis.

source.title: An R83W mutation in Rab3A causes autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia
source.quote: Affected individuals presented with adult-onset, gradually progressive cerebellar symptoms, often accompanied by mild gait spasticity and tremors.
